proposal.hypothesis: The selected row-parallel r-k-c parent is valid at 0.009476691 s. Earlier row-parallel variants with explicit SIMD and with k unrolling plus SIMD were also valid but slower (0.010415142 s and 0.009647238 s). This contrasting follow-up tiles each output row into 32 columns, accumulates each tile locally in ascending k order, then writes each output element once. It may reduce repeated C read-modify-write traffic, at the cost of accessing B in column chunks; the outcome is unmeasured.

retained: Retain static OpenMP parallelism over independent rows, capped by the caller-provided thread count.
Replace repeated output-element read-modify-write updates with a 32-column local accumulator tile; traverse k in ascending order and columns contiguously within each B chunk.
Assign every supported-size output element from a zero-initialized local accumulator; preserve zero-output behavior for unsupported sizes.
